reveal_en: Certain species of jellyfish, like Turritopsis dohrnii, can revert to an earlier stage of their life cycle after reaching sexual maturity. They essentially bypass death by aging, repeatedly transforming themselves.
reveal_zh: 某些水母，如灯塔水母，在性成熟后能逆转回生命早期阶段。它们通过反复转化，基本上避开了衰老带来的死亡。
meaning_en: This biological anomaly challenges our fundamental understanding of aging and the fixed nature of life cycles.
meaning_zh: 这种生物异常挑战了我们对衰老和生命周期固定性的基本理解。

visual.motion: Slow, pulsing underwater glow, subtle transformation.
